title: “Super Bob” Taylor.
deck: A goalscorer for the rebuilding years.
body: Bob Taylor became one of the faces of Albion’s route back from the third tier. The club’s Legend Days profile places him at the heart of the goalscoring story of the 1990s.

His Albion career also included a return that mattered at the other end of the table: five goals in eight matches helped the club avoid relegation, with Taylor scoring in a final-day 2–0 win over champions Charlton. It is the sort of contribution that explains why a player stays in supporters’ affections long after the match reports have faded.
